items.briefing:
Australians are being warned about two active scam threats right now. Proofpoint has flagged myGov impersonation scams and fake invoice emails targeting people in Australia — both designed to steal personal or financial information. Separately, the National Anti-Scam Centre has reached out to over 10,000 Australians caught up in an international cryptocurrency scam investigation, so if you receive contact from Scamwatch, take it seriously.

On the broader security front, many businesses are adopting AI faster than they can govern it safely, raising risks around data handling and decision-making. If you receive any unexpected email claiming to be from myGov or requesting invoice payment, do not click links — go directly to the official website instead.

featured.title: Proofpoint warns of myGov & invoice scams in Australia
featured.quote: Australians lost $2.18 billion to scams in 2025, with government services targeted.
